articles.title: Petrol, diesel prices may rise after Diwali: What crude oil at $140 a barrel means for consumers
articles.titleEn: Petrol, diesel prices may rise after Diwali: What crude oil at $140 a barrel means for consumers
articles.summary: Petrol and diesel prices could rise after Diwali as surging crude oil prices and higher shipping costs increase pressure on the government and oil marketing companies, energy expert Narendra Taneja told Business Today TV. With dated Brent touching $140 per barrel, the key question is how long India can shield consumers from rising fuel costs.
